source.name: Battle Armor
source.originalDescription: The critical-hit modifier of enemies is reduced by 50% when dealing damage to Falinks. Falinks can hold 10 more Aeos Energy than other Pokémon. Falinks is a group comprised of the Brass and five Troopers. Each member of the group has a separate hitbox and counts as a different target. The Brass always takes 10% reduced damage. Troopers will take 90% less damage while attached to the Brass. For attacks or moves that can hit multiple targets, the total damage Falinks can take from a single move or attack is 110% of that move or attack's damage.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Battle Armor は 受けるダメージを軽減する、味方へ付着または移動する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, or after the user uses Tackle, Megahorn, or Iron Head. Boosted attacks also apply a 50% slow for 1s to opposing Pokémon they hit. When a boosted attack hits, the cooldown of Tackle, Megahorn, or Iron Head is reduced by 2.5s

source.name: Dust Devil Formation
source.originalDescription: Has the five troopers run continuously around the Brass at great speed for 5s, dealing damage and slowing enemies hit by 20% for 1s. Falinks is unstoppable during the formation change for 0.25s. While this move is being used, damage taken by the troopers is reduced. While in Dust Devil formation the Troopers take 30% less damage making the Trooper's total damage reduction 93%. Moving counter to the rotation of the troopers will grant more hits against that target, and moving along the rotation will reduce the number of hits. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Dust Devil Formation は 移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
